control_flow.shape: one whole-body gate, one outer counted loop over ids, one inner counted loop over placements, one optional recursion, and one conditional cleanup
loops: 0x00b9aaa8..0x00b9b062: the id loop. Entered only when [EBP+0x10] != 0 (JBE at 0x00b9aaab skips). Increments [ESP+0x34] and continues while it is unsigned-below [EBP+0x10] (JC at 0x00b9b062).

0x00b9ad62..0x00b9b04c: the placement loop. Its counter is the INTEGER at [ESP+0x1c], decremented by SUB dword ptr [ESP + 0x1c],0x1 and tested with JNZ back to 0x00b9ad62. Because the branch target reloads [ESP + 0x3c] into EDI, the ring index restarts at 0 on every pass. The pseudocode's float countdown is a decompiler artefact.
early_exits: 0x00b9aa53 JZ 0x00b9b082 - a null 0x015fcc74 skips the entire body
0x00b9aaab JBE 0x00b9b068 - a zero id count skips the loop and goes straight to the cleanup
0x00b9aac9 JZ 0x00b9b056 - a null resolved record advances to the next id
0x00b9ab06 JLE 0x00b9b056 - both selection attempts failing advances to the next id
0x00b9abe8 JLE 0x00b9b056 - a non-positive placement count advances to the next id
0x00b9abf9 JC 0x00b9b056 - roll < threshold rejects the id

semantic_contract: Given an out-parameter Vector3, an array of count 32-bit ids, and one opaque extra value, this routine places instances on a cube map. For each id it asks Editors::cSpeciesManager for the record, running a two-attempt selection where the retry differs only in its final flag; a failure at either step skips the id silently. From the record it derives a placement count by drawing a uniform value in the record's [+0x300, +0x304] range, clamping it into the same interval and truncating toward zero, then computes an acceptance threshold by scaling one component of a property-supplied vector (default 1,1,1) by a property-supplied probability (default 1.0). The id is accepted only when the count is positive and a second uniform draw is less than or equal to that threshold. On acceptance the routine bumps a process-global dword serial at 0x016895a4, reads a second property vector (default 0,0,0) whose selected component, when positive, wraps the serial into 1..that value, offsets the record's +0x2e0 and +0x2e4 floats by a delta sampled from the game input manager, and reads three boolean properties (keys 0x80cd38c6, 0x3a509d24, 0x835025da, defaulting to false, to the 0x01654c01 mode flag, and to false) which it packs into bits 0x10, 0x20 and 0x40 of a dword. It then repeats, for as many placements as the derived count, a cube-map free-cell search (0x00b97720) around the incoming direction, constrained by two radii taken either from consecutive elements of the record's float array at +0x39c (when it holds two or more elements) or from the constants 100.0f and 1000.0f, and by the record's byte at +0x334 and the packed flag mask. Each success commits one instance through 0x00b93f40, paints flag bits 0x10/0x20/0x40 into the 12-byte cube-map cells within three record-supplied radii (0x00b90ea0, touching only cells whose low three bits are clear), optionally recurses into a uint32 array property (key 0xdb9bfc2c) via 0x00b9b090, and recurses into the record's own child-id array at +0x3b0 with the just-placed position as the next input direction. Except in the 0x01654c01 mode, every successful placement also does sorted-table bookkeeping: a two-dword key {serial, record+0x14} is lower-bounded in the 16-byte-record table at 0x0168890c..0x01688910 and, when the key is new or the table is empty, four dwords are copied out of a pseudo-randomly chosen element. One uniform draw whose result is discarded is executed between the bookkeeping and the commit, and it shifts every later draw. Finally the one heap block allocated at the top is released if its four-byte cookie is non-zero. The function returns nothing; all its effect is on the out-parameter, the cube map, the global serial and the sorted table.
classification_rationale: The whole 430-instruction body was read from the disassembly, the ABI is fixed by three callsites and by the EBP frame, all field offsets, constants, globals, branch polarities and the recursion are anchored to instruction addresses, and the two decompiler artefacts (the integer countdown and the dead quotient) were resolved from the bytes. That rules out STRUCTURAL_ONLY and STILL_UNKNOWN. It is not STRONG_SEMANTIC because two material elements are bounded rather than established: (1) the class that owns the per-id record is unidentified -- none of its nineteen read offsets appears in any SDK structure, the 0x19a8-byte stride observed at the caller matches no known type, and the nearest SDK-named function in the same block (Simulator::cPlantSpeciesManager::CreatePlantItem at 0x00b90560) is 0x4b0 away and therefore only a family hint; (2) fifteen of the twenty-seven callees are opaque ports, and in particular the two central ones -- 0x00b97720's 17-argument cube-map search and 0x00b93f40's commit -- are characterised only by their read bodies, not by an identity, and the seven property keys that drive every decision in the body are unnamed because none appears in the SDK and no reader was located.
semantic_findings: The routine is a placement pass, not a query: it returns void and mutates an out-parameter Vector3, a cube map, a process-global serial and a sorted table.
It is mutually recursive with 0x00b9b090 and self-recursive through the record's child-id array, with no depth limit in the body.
The placement count is a truncated uniform draw, not a rounded one: CVTSS2SI truncates toward zero and the pseudocode's ROUND() is an artefact.
The inner countdown at [ESP+0x1c] is an integer, and its loop-back target reloads the ring index, so the ring index restarts at zero on every placement.
The unsigned DIV at 0x00b9adb4 keeps only the remainder; the quotient is overwritten one instruction later and is dead.
A uniform draw at 0x00b9af7b is computed and discarded. It is preserved in the reconstruction because it advances the LCG and therefore perturbs every later draw in the same call.

The three boolean properties default to (false, is_creature_stage, false) in the order the pseudocode misleadingly names local_de/local_df/local_e0; the middle default is the mode byte, not a constant true.
has_ring is (end - begin) >> 2 >= 2, so an array of exactly one element uses the 100.0f/1000.0f fallbacks, not the array.
The acceptance test is roll <= threshold, not roll < threshold: COMISS sets CF on less-than and unordered, and the observed branch is JC, so an ordered equality is accepted.

The sorted-table bookkeeping is suppressed in the 0x01654c01 mode, and it fires when the key is absent OR when the table is empty -- the JZ at 0x00b9aeb5 tests the lower bound against a stack copy, not against the table end.

The cube-map cells are 12 bytes, matching Spore/Graphics/cCubeMapCoord, and the low three bits of the first dword are occupancy flags: 0x00b90ea0 refuses to touch a cell whose (dword & 7) is non-zero.
0x00b88590 is a fixed 128-per-face cube-map sampler returning a 10-bit value, which is why the caller 0x00b9c830 can compare its result against a stack dword before deciding to call.
Every property read goes through record->+0x43c, and the three GetBool calls pass the address of a byte that already holds a default, so they are read-modify-write rather than plain queries.
The whole body is gated on [0x015fcc74] being non-null, and the id loop is gated on the count being non-zero unsigned.
unresolved_questions: What class owns the per-id record read at +0x10, +0x14, +0x2d4..+0x310, +0x334, +0x39c/+0x3a0, +0x3b0/+0x3b4 and +0x43c? No SDK structure matches these offsets, and the 0x19a8-byte stride at the caller 0x00b9c830 matches no known type.

What do the seven property keys 0x4934caca, 0x1ee4cafd, 0x6b152f47, 0x80cd38c6, 0x3a509d24, 0x835025da and 0xdb9bfc2c name? None appears in the SDK, and no listener or definition site for the three bool keys was located.

What is the sorted table at 0x0168890c..0x01688910 holding, and what does its 16-byte element layout mean? It starts empty in the file image and the target only ever reads from it through lower_bound helpers.

What does 0x00b97720's 17th argument (the selector byte from record+0x334) select between the whole-map scan and the neighbourhood scan, and what are its six float arguments past the flag mask? The two scan paths were read but not characterised.

What is 0x00b93f40 actually committing? It creates an instance from a factory looked up with 0x036be27e, fills the magic values 0x091fe517b and 0x01be418e and the constant 5 at +0x140, and calls vtable slots +0x38 and +0x3c, but the instance's class was not identified.
What is the global at 0x015fcc74 that gates the whole body, and the one at 0x0167eae0 whose getter is called and discarded?

What is the input-manager delta from 0x00b7e390 semantically? It is added to two record floats that become the search's 9th and 10th arguments, which suggests a time or camera offset, but that is inference.
What is the game mode 0x01654c01, whose presence both supplies a flag default and suppresses the sorted-table bookkeeping?

The values of 0x016895a4, 0x0156c060, 0x01688890/94/98, 0x0168890c/10/20 and 0x0167eaec are all runtime state and are zero in the file image, so the component selector, the bucket default and the table contents are not statically predictable.
Five of the eight recorded callsites (0x00b9cc2c, 0x00b9d327, 0x00b9d806, 0x00b9f84e, 0x00ba1b01, 0x00ba1bad) were not disassembled.

A runtime trace is required to observe whether the sorted table at 0x0168890c ever becomes non-empty, which is the only way to learn its element layout.

body_reconstruction.claim_scope: The 430-instruction body is reconstructed with every offset, constant, branch polarity and recursion preserved. Twenty-seven callees are modelled as declared ports with no invented bodies. The per-id record is declared with only the nineteen offsets the function reads and the intervening gaps kept as padding; no class layout is invented.
preserved_semantics: void return; no EAX write on any path
four __cdecl stack arguments read through EBP
the placement count truncates toward zero and is then decremented as an integer
the ring index restarts at zero on every placement because the loop-back target reloads it
the ring wrap keeps only the remainder of (i + 2) % count
the acceptance comparison is roll <= threshold
the three bool defaults are false, the 0x01654c01 mode byte, and false, in GetBool call order
has_ring requires at least two array elements before the 100.0f/1000.0f fallbacks are bypassed
the sorted-table block is skipped in the 0x01654c01 mode and fires on key-absent OR table-empty
the discarded random draw is kept, because it perturbs the LCG
the out-context block is freed only when both the pointer and its four-byte cookie are non-zero
